source: ChatGPT-6 Astra (Ultra), 9 September 2026, the stall-and-recovery evaluation packet (ss_stall.zip) returned to the operator; filed 10 September 2026 under docs/notes/stall-and-recovery-proposal-2026-09-10.md. Verbatim givens and expectations; the ids and the why lines are the project's.
description: Deferred-plane fixtures for an orchestration layer this repository does not contain: bounded retries by strategy fingerprint, a watchdog outside the call, partial-work preservation, side-effect replay, a circuit breaker. Adopted as a description of what the layer must do when it exists; nothing here is built. The retry taxonomy shapes the one automatic retry of the intake failure rule (ADR-0022 (Proposed), 10 September 2026).

cases.name: equivalent_timeout_stops_after_bound
cases.why: Two identical attempts with the same transient error stop; the intake retry of ADR-0022 (Proposed) (10 September) takes this bound as one automatic retry, never two.

cases.name: materially_different_strategy_is_allowed
cases.why: A retry that changes something material is a new attempt, not a repeat.

cases.name: invalid_auth_never_blind_retries
cases.why: A non-retryable class goes straight to the failure path; the intake rule's retry never fires on it.

cases.name: watchdog_detects_no_progress
cases.why: Liveness is judged from outside the call; a worker never watches itself.

cases.name: healthy_long_job_is_not_killed
cases.why: A quiet job inside its window is not a stall; heartbeat traffic is not progress and silence is not death.

cases.name: partial_work_survives_failure
cases.why: What finished is reported as finished; a failure at the last step is not a failure of the whole.

cases.name: unsafe_side_effect_replay_is_blocked
cases.why: A lost acknowledgement on a side-effecting action is never replayed blind.

cases.name: circuit_breaker_opens_after_dependency_failure_threshold
cases.why: A dependency that keeps failing is stopped as a dependency, not retried per call.
